title: Shams Dubai
finding: Grid connection and credit framework; customer-specific approval required.

title: DEWA D33 Solar PV Initiative
finding: Company captive PV program with its own conditions, not a general grant.

title: DEWA enrolled contractors
finding: Use current enrolled electrical and DRRG solar PV providers. Enrollment is not an endorsement.

title: DEWA connection process
finding: Design, inspection, agreement and meter coordination through enrolled contractor.

title: Abu Dhabi self-supply licensing guide
finding: Effective 2023 guide says small-scale residential PV licensing and net metering remain suspended, with specified exceptions. Obtain written current DoE/TAQA position.

title: Abu Dhabi older netting regulation
finding: Older credit carry-forward framework conflicts with suspension guidance for sales planning. No export revenue underwrite.

title: Hub71 Access
finding: AED 250,000 in-kind plus AED 250,000 cash for equity; relocation expectations. Confirm term sheet and cohort.

title: MBRIF FAQ
finding: Accelerator nonfinancial support; Guarantee Scheme debt supported by guarantee, not a grant.

title: Khalifa Fund funding scheme
finding: Product-specific financing; UAE national ownership and Abu Dhabi criteria. Confirm program-specific age/company-age requirements.

title: NEXUS application announcement
finding: 2026 deadline 20 September has passed. Eligibility includes Emirati ownership/residence conditions.

title: Mohammed Bin Rashid Fund registration
finding: Funding registration states business 100% owned and managed by UAE nationals. Founder nationality unknown.

title: Startup India recognition
finding: Recognition process, not automatic cash award. Verify latest recognition thresholds and entity eligibility directly.

title: Startup India Seed Fund portal
finding: Portal search notice lists last startup application date 31 May 2026. Treat current cycle as closed to new applications.

title: SISFS guidelines
finding: Historical scheme grant up to INR 20 lakh and debt/convertible support up to INR 50 lakh; incorporation, DPIIT, shareholding and prior-support tests apply.

title: NIDHI PRAYAS 2.0 innovators
finding: Current program describes PC support up to INR 20 lakh or APC up to INR 40 lakh, subject to selection. Centre-specific call required. Older DST page still describes INR 10 lakh version.

title: DST legacy PRAYAS overview
finding: Legacy INR 10 lakh description; do not substitute it for PRAYAS 2.0 call rules.

title: ELEVATE NxT 2026
finding: Page shows active NxT deeptech call up to INR 1 crore; deadline 14 December 2026 at 17:00 IST. Commercial solar assembly alone does not establish deeptech eligibility.

title: T-Hub startup programs
finding: Incubation and sustainability programs; no universal cash entitlement.

title: Startup India Tamil Nadu 2026 report
finding: TANSEED described as seed equity initiative; current cohort terms and deadline require separate verification.

title: PM Surya Ghar consumer manual
finding: Residential customer process. Standard central support commonly INR 30,000 per kW for first 2 kW plus INR 18,000 third kW, capped INR 78,000. Confirm latest category/location/vendor/DCR rules.

title: Telangana rooftop regulation 1 of 2025
finding: 2025 regulatory source rather than older FAQ; feasibility and connection approvals remain required.

title: BESCOM national portal
finding: KERC and BESCOM consumer-specific PPA and connection process; page references July 2025 order.

title: MSEDCL rooftop process
finding: Net metering/net billing applications and current circulars. Recheck amendments and ToD treatment at proposal date.

title: SURYA Gujarat FAQ
finding: Portal/vendor pathway; Ahmedabad may be Torrent territory, establish actual licensee before quote.

title: Tamil Nadu solar portal
finding: Solar application, DCR/ALMM and net feed-in information. Do not use Dubai credit rules.

title: BSES rooftop FAQ September 2025
finding: Delhi licensee application pathway; NCR also includes Haryana/UP with different rules.

title: CBUAE exchange rates
finding: USD/AED 3.6725 used for budget conversion. INR exchange rate in model is an editable assumption, not a current quote.

title: SolarEdge Q3 2026 results
finding: Q3 revenue USD 326.1m illustrates hardware scale/cyclicality; not a Welos valuation multiple.

title: Enphase investor relations
finding: Q3 2026 results dated 27 October 2026 available. Use filings for scale and risk review; no observed trading multiple imported.

title: ABB Sensorfact acquisition announcement
finding: Energy-management SaaS acquisition strategic precedent, not a disclosed transaction-multiple benchmark.

title: SEWA official services
finding: Official authority/service contact route. No export-credit entitlement verified in this review. Obtain written conditions.

title: FTA Free Zone Persons guide
finding: Qualifying Free Zone Persons may apply 0% to qualifying income, subject to conditions; not a blanket exemption or grant. Obtain tax advice for exact entity/activity.

title: MNRE Solar PV Module PLI Scheme
finding: Production-linked support for selected high-efficiency solar PV manufacturers. No new application window or Welos eligibility verified. Monitoring assembly is not module manufacturing.

title: Natural Earth country boundaries
finding: Public-domain generalized geographic outlines. Research markers are illustrative, not installations.
